report_name: Airbus Moves Critical Apps to European Cloud to Avoid US CLOUD Act

identities.name: Airbus
identities.description: European aerospace and defense leader that selected French cloud provider Scaleway to host critical applications, aiming to shield them from non-European laws like the US CLOUD Act.

identities.name: Scaleway
identities.description: French cloud provider, a division of Iliad Group, chosen by Airbus for a sovereign cloud partnership to protect applications from extraterritorial laws.

identities.name: Amazon Web Services
identities.description: U.S.-based hyperscale cloud provider from which Airbus is migrating 70 critical applications due to jurisdictional concerns related to the US CLOUD Act.

identities.name: Iliad Group
identities.description: French telecom group and parent company of Scaleway.

identities.name: Google Cloud
identities.description: Mentioned as an example of a U.S.-headquartered cloud provider whose customers could be subject to the US CLOUD Act.

identities.name: Microsoft Azure
identities.description: Mentioned as an example of a U.S.-headquartered cloud provider whose customers could be subject to the US CLOUD Act.
